description: This file contains shared beacon code for the game Unvanquished, including beacon management, configuration, rendering, and UI interaction. It handles explicit beacons from game entities and implicit beacons for enemy sensing, with functions for loading configs, setting positions, sorting, highlighting, and visual effects.

methods.name: TargetTeam
methods.description: Determines the team (ALIENS or HUMANS) associated with a beacon based on its type and flags.

methods.name: CG_LoadBeaconsConfig
methods.description: Loads beacon configuration from 'ui/beacons.cfg', parsing parameters for visual and behavioral settings.

methods.name: SetClientBeaconPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of a beacon based on the exact location of a target entity, with upward adjustment for human players.

methods.name: LoadExplicitBeacons
methods.description: Populates cg.beacons with explicit beacons from game entities, filtering expired or invalid beacons.

methods.name: LoadImplicitBeacons
methods.description: Generates implicit beacons for enemy sensing when the player is an alive alien, based on nearby enemy players.

methods.name: CompareBeaconsByDist
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting beacons by distance.

methods.name: MarkRelevantBeacons
methods.description: Marks the nearest buildable beacons as relevant for low health or ammo situations.

methods.name: SetHighlightedBeacon
methods.description: Determines which beacon is currently highlighted based on view angle.

methods.name: IsHighlighted
methods.description: Checks if a beacon is the currently highlighted one.

methods.name: DrawBeacon
methods.description: Handles visual effects, animations, and sounds for a beacon each frame.

methods.name: HandHLBeaconToUI
methods.description: Prepares highlighted beacon data for UI display, including icon, name, distance, age, and owner.

methods.name: CG_RunBeacons
methods.description: Main function to load, sort, mark, highlight, animate beacons, and pass data to UI.

methods.name: CG_BeaconIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon handle for a beacon based on its type and highlight status.

methods.name: CG_BeaconDescriptiveIcon
methods.description: Returns a more descriptive icon for beacons, such as class or buildable icons.

methods.name: CG_BeaconName
methods.description: Generates a display name for a beacon based on its type, owner, and team.
